add-digital-signature-to-pdf-page.title: Digitally Sign First Page of PDF with Visible Signature
add-digital-signature-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, create a visible signature rectangle, load a PKCS#7 certificate, and apply a digital signature to the first page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-second-digital-signature-to-pdf-page.title: Add Multiple Digital Signatures to a PDF Page
add-second-digital-signature-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to place two digital signature fields on the same PDF page and sign them using a PFX certificate.

suppress-reason-location-when-signing-pd.title: Sign PDF with PKCS7 and Suppress Signature Details
suppress-reason-location-when-signing-pd.description: Demonstrates signing a PDF using a PKCS#7 certificate with Aspose.Pdf while hiding location, reason, and contact information by setting empty strings and customizing the signature appearance.

sign-pdf-french-caption.title: Sign PDF with French Signature Caption
sign-pdf-french-caption.description: Shows how to digitally sign a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and force the signature caption to French by setting the SignatureCustomAppearance locale.

remove-signature-from-pdf.title: Remove Signature from PDF
remove-signature-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete a named digital signature from a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature.

verify-pdf-signature-by-name.title: Verify PDF Signature 'ContractSigner'
verify-pdf-signature-by-name.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades and check whether a digital signature named 'ContractSigner' exists and is valid using the VerifySigned method.

validate-manager-signature.title: Verify PDF Signature Field
validate-manager-signature.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature and verify the cryptographic integrity of a specific signature field.

extract-signing-certificate-from-pdf.title: Extract Signing Certificate from PDF Signature Field
extract-signing-certificate-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate a signature field in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract the embedded signing certificate, and save it as a .cer file.

extract-witness-signature-image.title: Extract Signature Field Appearance as PNG
extract-witness-signature-image.description: Demonstrates how to extract the visual appearance of a PDF form field (e.g., a witness signature) and save it as a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

custom-pdf-signature-appearance.title: Hide "Digitally signed by" Caption in PDF Signature
custom-pdf-signature-appearance.description: Demonstrates how to create a custom signature appearance that removes the default "Digitally signed by" label, add a signature field, and sign a PDF using a PKCS#7 certificate with Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-pfx-certificate.title: Sign PDF with PFX Certificate
sign-pdf-with-pfx-certificate.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF document using a password‑protected PFX certificate with Aspose.Pdf. The example creates a signature field, applies a PKCS#1 signature, and saves the signed file.

remove-pdf-signature-missing-handling.title: Remove PDF Signature Field with Error Handling
remove-pdf-signature-missing-handling.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, attempting to remove a specific signature field, handling the case where the field is missing, and saving the updated document.

log-pdf-signature-verification-to-json.title: Verify PDF Signatures and Export Results to JSON
log-pdf-signature-verification-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to load a signed PDF, enumerate its digital signatures, verify each one, and write the verification results (signature name and validity) to a formatted JSON file.

sign-and-verify-pdf-using-pdffilesignatu.title: Sign and Verify PDF Using PdfFileSignature
sign-and-verify-pdf-using-pdffilesignatu.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF with a PFX certificate using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature and then immediately verify the signature's authenticity.

sign-pdf-with-reason-and-location.title: Sign PDF with Reason and Location using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-reason-and-location.description: Demonstrates how to add a visible digital signature to a PDF and set the signature reason and location using Aspose.Pdf's PKCS7 class.

add-signature-field-and-sign-pdf.title: Add Signature Field and Sign PDF on Specific Page
add-signature-field-and-sign-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create an empty signature field on a chosen page of a PDF and then apply a visible PKCS#7 digital signature using Aspose.Pdf Facade APIs.

extract-certificate-details-from-pdf-sig.title: Extract Certificate Details from PDF Signature Field
extract-certificate-details-from-pdf-sig.description: Loads a signed PDF, iterates through its form fields, and extracts the X.509 certificate information (issuer and expiration date) from each signature field.

generate-pdf-signature-report.title: Generate PDF Signature Verification Report
generate-pdf-signature-report.description: Loads a signed PDF, extracts each signature field, obtains signer details and signing time, verifies the signatures, and creates a new PDF containing a table that summarizes the verification results.

sign-pdf-with-retry-on-file-lock.title: Retry PDF Signing When File Is Locked
sign-pdf-with-retry-on-file-lock.description: Demonstrates how to sign a PDF with a certificate using Aspose.Pdf while handling file‑locking issues by implementing a retry mechanism.

remove-all-signatures-from-pdf.title: Remove All Signatures from a PDF
remove-all-signatures-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a signed PDF, enumerate its digital signatures with PdfFileSignature, delete each signature, and save a clean copy.

verify-multiple-pdf-signatures.title: Verify Multiple Signatures in a PDF Document
verify-multiple-pdf-signatures.description: The example loads a signed PDF, retrieves all signature names (including inactive ones), and verifies each signature using Aspose.Pdf.Facades to report whether it is valid or invalid.

extract-signature-images-html-report.title: Extract Signature Images from PDF and Embed in HTML Report
extract-signature-images-html-report.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates through its pages, extracts all embedded images (e.g., signatures), converts them to Base64 data URLs, and generates an HTML file that displays the images for visual inspection.

sign-pdf-with-semi-transparent-appearanc.title: Configure Semi-Transparent Background for PDF Signature
sign-pdf-with-semi-transparent-appearanc.description: Demonstrates adding a signature field to a PDF, signing it with a PKCS7 certificate, and setting a semi‑transparent yellow background for the signature appearance.

list-signature-names-in-pdf.title: List Signature Field Names in a PDF
list-signature-names-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve all digital signature field names from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

sign-pdf-with-visible-image-signature.title: Apply Signature Image to PDF Pages
sign-pdf-with-visible-image-signature.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp from a signature image, positioning it at the bottom‑right of each page, and saving the signed document.

sign-pdf-visible-signature-last-page.title: Add Visible Signature to Bottom‑Right of Last PDF Page
sign-pdf-visible-signature-last-page.description: Shows how to create a visible signature field on the bottom‑right corner of the last page of a PDF and then sign it with a PFX certificate using Aspose.Pdf.

locale-specific-pdf-digital-signature.title: Locale‑Specific PDF Digital Signature (German, Spanish, Japanese)
locale-specific-pdf-digital-signature.description: Demonstrates signing a PDF with Aspose.Pdf using a PKCS7 certificate while providing language‑specific Reason and Location fields. Also shows how to configure a custom visual appearance for the signature.

remove-and-replace-pdf-signature.title: Remove Existing Signatures and Re‑sign PDF with a New Certificate
remove-and-replace-pdf-signature.description: Demonstrates how to delete all existing digital signatures from a PDF and then apply a new PKCS#7 signature using a different certificate.

verify-absence-of-pdf-signature.title: Check if PDF Contains Digital Signatures
verify-absence-of-pdf-signature.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature to verify whether a PDF file has any digital signatures, expecting false for an unsigned document.

remove-all-signatures-from-pdfs.title: Remove All Signatures from PDFs Recursively
remove-all-signatures-from-pdfs.description: The script walks through a directory tree, loads each PDF, deletes every signature field, and overwrites the original file with an unsigned version.

extract-certificate-serial-number-from-p.title: Extract Signing Certificate Serial Number from PDF Signature
extract-certificate-serial-number-from-p.description: Loads a PDF, locates signature fields, extracts the signing X509 certificate, and logs its serial number for audit purposes.

list-signature-reasons-and-locations.title: List Signature Reason and Location from PDF
list-signature-reasons-and-locations.description: Shows how to open a PDF, iterate over its form fields, identify signature fields, and extract the Reason and Location information from the underlying PKCS7 signature object.

hide-pdf-signature-appearance.title: Create Hidden Digital Signature in PDF
hide-pdf-signature-appearance.description: Demonstrates signing a PDF with a cryptographically valid digital signature that has no visible appearance by using a zero‑size rectangle and disabling visibility.

extract-signing-certificate-subject-dn.title: Extract Signing Certificate Subject DN from PDF Signatures
extract-signing-certificate-subject-dn.description: Demonstrates how to load a signed PDF, iterate over signature fields, extract the signing X509 certificate, retrieve its subject distinguished name, and store the information in a data table (simulating a database).
